title: PromptPack: Training-Free Augmentation of Diffusion Editors for Intent-Aligned Spatial and Semantic Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.21865v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many image-editing tasks require confining changes to intended spatial regions while exactly preserving user-designated source content. Instruction-driven editing pipelines often leave such user-intent underspecified, while inpainting editors condition generation on explicitly defined edit support but not on the spatial assignment of individual edit concepts. PromptPack addresses both limitations by equipping diffusion editors with two explicit 'Edit Guides': an edit-role partition that labels each pixel as 'Keep,' 'Permit,' or 'Modify' to specify where edits may occur, and a regional-prompt assignment that maps spatial regions to text prompts to specify which concepts apply where. These guides may be manually specified or, for source-object edits, automatically derived from a text-grounded SAM 3 mask. translated_title: PromptPack：通过免训练方式增强扩散编辑器，实现与意图对齐的空间与语义控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.21865v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：许多图像编辑任务要求将修改限制在预期的空间区域内，同时精确保留用户指定的源内容。基于指令的编辑流程往往使这类用户意图未被充分明确，而修补类编辑器仅以明确定义的编辑支持区域为生成条件，却不考虑各个编辑概念的空间分配。PromptPack 通过为扩散编辑器配备两种显式的“编辑指南”来同时克服这两个局限：一是编辑角色划分，将每个像素标注为“保留”、“允许”或“修改”，以指定允许在何处进行编辑；二是区域提示分配，将空间区域映射到文本提示，以指定哪些概念应用于何处。这些指南可以手动指定，或者对于源对象编辑，可以从基于文本的 SAM 3 掩码自动推导。在无需重新训练的情况下，PromptPack 将独立嵌入的区域提示注入编辑器的固定长度文本序列中，并利用编辑角色划分来……
tldr: PromptPack 通过免训练地为扩散编辑器引入“保留/允许/修改”像素角色划分和区域到提示的空间映射两种显式编辑指南，实现了与用户意图对齐的空间与语义精确控制。
en_tdlr: PromptPack training-free augments diffusion editors with an explicit Keep/Permit/Modify pixel-role partition and regional-prompt assignment, enabling intent-aligned spatial and semantic control.
